scope.description: OKLG scavenger Main/Hold, selection and assistance eligibility; no desired recovery edges added.
covered: Shared FlyTo mixed-mode fuel-accounting witness and patched handoff
opaque: Full comms scheduling and response selection
preconditions: Ordinary Main paths have no higher-priority intervention unless explicitly modeled.
Derelict docking/fuel state is a supplied native outcome, not synthesized.
LowFuel, bingo and GetRCSRemain<1kg are different predicates.
ATC resolves to OKLG for OKLG examples; vanilla code chooses nearest regional station/fallback ID.
notProven: Universal inability to escape through external directives/player help
All mod interactions or complete effective simulation

undock.symbol: Undock RunCommand / shallow and loaded departure

target.symbol: TargetNewIfNone selection, low-fuel path and RequestHelp

fix_scav_recovery.symbol: ScavEmergencyRecovery visit, home feasibility and help lifecycle

station_collision_native.symbol: Ship collision scan/response and projectile/body separation
anchors: private static void ProcessCollision(Ship a, Ship b

station_collision_policy.symbol: Station docking-chain policy and physical prefix

station_collision_scan.symbol: Existing collision/proximity scan with station-attached candidate filtering

review.supports: Reviewed native control flow and shipped data; desired recovery is kept outside the native/effective graph.

native_hold.supports: Actual ScavPilot Main, Hold and StickySequence bodies: repeated empty-fuel hold; exact 1 kg boundary; help flag; refueling release. Unity/condition boundaries substituted explicitly.

native_spec.supports: Native JsonShipSpec.Matches rejects attached and accepts detached target for nIsDocked=-1. Not a full comms/dispatch simulation.

mixed_accounting.supports: Native FlyTo dispatch/accounting and NavData fuel debit reproduce manual/planned/manual duplication. Production patches preserve remaining fuel, subsequent spending, repeated handoffs and vanilla-compatible save/load. Prescribed geometry/collision inputs and substituted steering leaves are explicit.

recovery_native.supports: Actual production patches in bundled Mono: ordinary Hold scope, feasibility exceptions, native SOS routing and failed-send controller retention.

escape_handoff.supports: 60 native caller/production-patch checks with explicit world/weapon/health/plan boundaries; whole police dispatch, shared escape leaves, Navy/Blockade controls and allocation. Full combat remains unexpanded.

avoidance_validation.supports: 844 checks including production native FlyTo replay for three anchors, original failure controls, motion oracle and allocation. Flight geometry/evasion remain unexpanded external outcomes in this transition slice; no live validation claimed.

station_traffic_validation.supports: 880 assertions: live-link scope, native proximity scan, physical prefix with counting body boundary, free-space/projectile/body controls and native shared FlyTo replay of both patrol and returning hauler. Native impact controls fail; production reaches original targets for three anchors. Full geometry remains unexpanded; no live success claim.

main.description: Actual Scav Main index. Queue commands do not automatically change it.

leaf.description: Active modeled control point, not full controller state.

fuel.description: GetRCSRemain kilograms, distinct from bingo delta-v and LowFuel.

hold_result.description: Native Hold return at the modeled boundary.

request.description: Attempting a send does not imply delivery.

registered.description: Station SOS paths can unregister caller before rescue succeeds.

help_origin.description: RequestHelp inside TargetNewIfNone versus explicitly injected SosOutOfFuel.

pause_early.description: fAIPauseTimer > 0 and fAIDockingExpire == 0 at Hold entry.

interrupt.description: Higher-priority directive/combat/threat is allowed to preempt Main.

low.description: Native LowFuel result: fraction < .25 or delta-v < 4*MaxSpeed.

player_eligible.description: Scav player-help distance and player-not-station-docked tests pass.

near_target.description: SOS target exists within 5 km; suppress station request.

send_ok.description: Native SendMessage availability checks permit SOS.

dispatch_ok.description: All station-reply conditions other than IsNotDocked pass.

haul_ok.description: A completed native DeployHauler attempt supplied a reachable, non-duplicate retriever. A still-running attempt has no value supplied here.

candidate_ok.description: Native GetTarget/FindTarget selects and accepts a candidate.

transfer_complete.description: Fuel transfer/replenishment and help removal actually completed.

planned_paid.description: A planned segment has already debited its own fuel for the intervening travel.

duplicate_debit.description: Manual accounting charged progress already covered by the planned segment.

stale_debit_exhausts.description: Externally established arithmetic: the stale manual charge would exhaust the post-plan tank; true in the native 100/80/30 kg reproduction.

manual_watermark.description: Manual TripFuelDTO.Progress relative to progress already paid by the planned path.

home_affordable.description: One-leg native delta-v predicate including rotor/interregional fusion exceptions, independent of null NavData.

scav_hold.label: Main[4]: docked Hold
scav_hold.detail: The low-fuel branch waits; it does not send SOS or advance to Undock.

scav_undock.label: Main[0]: Undock
scav_undock.detail: Physical departure is native and can need a manned nav console when fully loaded.

scav_target.label: Main[1]: TargetNewIfNone
scav_target.detail: Reached after Undock. None of the low-fuel checks preempt Main[4].

scav_fly.label: Main[2]: FlyTo
scav_fly.detail: Fuel reservation/planner results are opaque inputs, not assumed perfect.

scav_dock.label: Main[3]: Dock
scav_dock.detail: Successful nonstation attachment leads to Hold; station retirement is a separate boundary.

scav_home_fly.label: Main[2]: low-fuel home target
scav_home_fly.detail: TargetData can be accepted with null NavData and zero DTO FuelCostRCS in low-fuel branch.

scav_request.label: RequestHelp routing
scav_request.detail: Reached by failed candidate search or an explicitly injected SOS; not by Hold expiry.

scav_station_send.label: Attempt regional-station SOS
scav_station_send.detail: Nearest regional station/fallback ATC ID; OKLG only when that resolves to OKLG.

scav_wait_player.label: Player-help handoff boundary
scav_wait_player.detail: Snapshot inside RequestHelp after sending; subsequent caller return/tree scheduling is not expanded. This node does not insert a Hold command. Accepted request marks help; declining does not itself clear it.

scav_station_reply.label: Station response eligibility
scav_station_reply.detail: ShipTestThem=IsNotDocked is on dispatch reply, not a universal SOS condition.

scav_dispatch.label: DeployHauler command
scav_dispatch.detail: Spawning can fail or reject unreachable calls; not guaranteed rescue/refueling.

scav_retriever.label: Retriever dispatched: external lifecycle
scav_retriever.detail: Continue in retriever model; hauling/retirement is not on-site fuel delivery.

scav_no_dispatch.label: No hauler dispatch from this reply
scav_no_dispatch.detail: Other inverse replies remain possible; no fabricated fallback rescue.

scav_cleanup.label: Unregister / native cleanup boundary
scav_cleanup.detail: No automatic poof assumed; TryInstantCleanup eligibility/native life cycle not expanded.

scav_suppressed.label: SOS suppressed within target proximity
scav_suppressed.detail: Standalone SOS returns before contacting ATC within 5 km of existing target.

scav_queue.label: SFF one-shot Hold
scav_queue.detail: Docked Hold FFWD ResolveInstantly only resets timer; one-shot does not release Main[4].

scav_external.label: Priority intervention / external behavior
scav_external.detail: Combat, threats, player help and queued directives can change the situation. No automatic emergency branch is invented.

scav_account_plan.label: Planned segment paid; manual watermark stale
scav_account_plan.detail: Shared FlyTo accounting boundary. Position/timing/fuel values are explicit native-fixture inputs, not computed by this discrete model.

scav_account_manual.label: Resume manual fuel accounting
scav_account_manual.detail: Native subtracts the stale progress increment; patched FetchFuelData advances the manual watermark before the native debit.

edges.note: Expired timer reset to -infinity; next call re-arms it. No SOS, no index change.
Help condition holds even after >=1 kg is restored.
This is not a homeward-fuel affordability check.
Failure at last Main child falls through to sequence reset; next pass begins at Undock. Not the ordinary empty Hold expiry.
ResolveInstantly resets Hold timer 1..30 and timestamp; no assistance or undock.
OneShot reports Finished independently of wrapped Hold; Main still at 4.
Explicit completed external fuel/help removal, not a built-in automatic rescue.
Loaded nav/crew or physical departure can keep Running; no promise of success.
After native departure/cleanup; no old scan/situ target retained in ordinary path.
Scav derelict selection uses outbound BingoFuelCheck; FindTarget free-target branch also tests return reserve. Anchored path planning validates outbound route. Not blanket lack of fuel checks.
Failed search reaches RequestHelp; event summarizes native attempts, not a guarantee the first random candidate fails.
LowFuel branch takes nearest GetTargetHome, not necessarily station of origin.
Non-null home is accepted even when GenerateNavData fails. Do not invent a RequestHelp transition here.
No native AmIOutOfFuel/SosOutOfFuel preemption in Scav tree. This does not prove physical flight cannot complete.
Native physical docking success supplied externally. This edge neither creates nor consumes fuel.
Native DockAndDespawn boundary, not an assertion about future spawn/fuel.
Only an explicit external injected command enters this path; tree does not choose it automatically.
40 km ordinarily, 120 km for close relation or missing captain/spec; player must not be station-docked.
Near-target early return precedes station send. For ordinary TargetNew failure both targets were null; relevant here to injected SOS.
Send availability and loot application assumed established; request itself does not undock.
Caller ignores SendMessage false; no fabricated ShipRequestedHelp condition.
Negative interaction does not contain ShipRemoveHelpRequest. Retry/fallback behavior not invented.
Station send caller unregisters; accepted delivery does not guarantee a retriever.
Caller still unregisters even if SendMessage returns false.
Authored SHIPSOSDispatchHauler requires IsNotDocked.
All remaining inverse-response range/condition/loot checks supplied as explicit native outcomes.
Spawned hauler, duplicate/area/bingo checks and native assignment succeeded. Not a promised arrival.

A completed attempt without a retriever, including rejected/unavailable spawn or failed reachability. A busy departure area returns Running and is outside this terminal event; it is not classified as failed dispatch.
A previously established manual ledger and a paid planned segment are scenario preconditions. This does not assert that every FlyTo or collision has such a segment.

The verified fixture starts this boundary with 30 kg and a stale 40 kg charge, so native RemoveGasMass drains it to zero without another movement. Not an assertion that any historical ship followed this trace.

findings.note: Conditional repeating native Main hold, not proof every stranded scav got here or that external help can never arrive.
Fuel alone is insufficient while request condition persists.
Home target is accepted despite null generated route; this alone does not prove it is physically unreachable.
Docked recipients cannot pass dispatch reply. Not a claim that station deliberately promises rescue first.
Two accounting modes charged overlapping progress. Numeric route generation and collision geometry remain outside the model.

scenarios.note: Empty fuel is initial evidence/input. No fuel exhaustion event is invented by graph.
ge1 includes exact 1 kg; native test separately checks threshold.
Native station help path exists. Dispatch/arrival is conditional, not guaranteed.
Injected SOS is explicit. Ordinary Main Hold does not reach it.

Native fixture: 100 -> 80 -> 30 -> 0 kg; patched retains 30 at unchanged position. The final fuel-exhaustion predicate is established by the native numeric test. Attribution to Host Terrapin remains unproved.
No planned-route-null inference: the separate native one-leg feasibility result is supplied explicitly.
